valproate.rec: 5.3.2 (Box 2 restrictions apply); Do not start sodium valproate for the first time in people (male or female) younger than 55 unless two specialists independently agree and document that there is no other effective, tolerated treatment, or that reproductive risks do not apply. In women and girls of childbearing potential, use only if other options failed and the Pregnancy Prevention Programme is in place.
